31700-XV.s: The bill establishes the 2009 departmental budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, including the departmental budget and the budget for the agency and inspectorate operating on a baten-lastendienst basis. The explanatory memorandum covers policy objectives, spending articles, and agency funding without introducing new executive delegations.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2009 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31792-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statute of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through the second supplementary budget, raising spending and revenue lines such as the Belastingdienst apparatus, DNB and AFM supervision fees, and the capital injections into ING, Aegon and SNS REAAL and the Fortis/AA securities purchase. It takes effect on 1 December 2008 and sets the budget figures in thousands of euros.
31792-IXB.j: The memorandum justifies the supplementary spending mainly by a College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven ruling on supervision cost charges and by the capital injections and securities purchases, not by any new delegation of power.
q: As a result of the ruling of the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (the CBb ruling), the government contribution in 2008 will be increased by a total of € 3.1 million.
Als gevolg van de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (de CBb-uitspraak) zal de overheidsbijdrage in 2008 in totaal met € 3,1 mln verhoogd worden.

31965-XI.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (XI) and the Waddenfonds, following the spring memorandum. It sets the revised budget figures in thousands of euros and provides that the law enters into force on 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
31965-XI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the economic situation and the need to inform Parliament of deviations from the original budget; it does not justify any delegation of power.
q: The supplementary budget is intended to submit (interim) deviations from the original budget to the States General.
De suppletore begroting is bedoeld om (tussentijds) afwijkingen ten opzichte van de oorspronkelijke begroting voor te leggen aan de Staten-Generaal.

32123-XV.s: This bill sets the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the baten-lastendiensten Agentschap SZW and Inspectie Werk en Inkomen, in thousands of euros. The accompanying memorandum describes policy goals on employment, youth unemployment, social assistance and pensions, with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) attached to this law for the year 2010 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32222-XV.s: The bill amends the 2009 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget for its agencies, following the autumn budget review (Najaarsnota). It sets the amended budget amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as 1 December 2009, with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

32395-IXB.s: The bill amends the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) by changing expenditure and revenue figures, following the Spring Memorandum. It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2010 (or the day after publication if later, with retroactive effect to 1 June).
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33000-XIII.s: The bill sets the 2012 departmental budget statement (XIII) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation at expenditure and receipts level, plus the operating-budget statement for its baten-lastendiensten. It also fixes that the amounts are stated in thousands of euros and specifies the entry-into-force rules.
q: The departmental budget statement (XIII) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation for the year 2012, attached to this act, is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie (XIII) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33090-XII.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statutes for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, the Dutch Emissions Authority (NEa) and the Waddenfonds, reallocating expenditure and revenue through the Najaarsnota. It makes the amendments effective from 1 December 2011, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The adoption of the budget statements referred to in articles 1 to 3 is made in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de in artikel 1 tot en met 3 bedoelde begrotingsstaat geschiedt in duizenden euro’s.

33605-VII.s: This slotwet amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and its baten-lastendiensten budget, adjusting appropriations and realised figures in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes.

33760-(R2010).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2010 Beijing Convention on suppressing unlawful acts relating to civil aviation and its 2010 Supplementary Protocol on unlawful seizure of aircraft, and sets entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad. It is a treaty-approval act with no domestic delegation of powers.
q: The Beijing Convention of 10 September 2010 on suppressing unlawful acts relating to civil aviation is approved for the entire Kingdom.
Het op 10 september 2010 te Beijing tot stand gekomen Verdrag tot bestrijding van wederrechtelijke gedragingen betreffende de burgerluchtvaart ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk.

parties: The VVD asks which states have ratified the Convention and Protocol and what consequences the government foresees for the Kingdom where jurisdiction covers cases involving non-ratifying countries.
Which parties have approved the Convention and the Protocol?
Welke partijen hebben het Verdrag en het Protocol goedgekeurd?

34350-XII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budgets of its executive agencies (Rijkswaterstaat, ILT, KNMI, NEa). It adjusts commitments, expenditures and receipts across policy articles, with the amendments set out in attached budget schedules and effective from 1 December 2015.
q: We have resolved, with joint consultation of the States General, that the departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment for 2015 is amended as shown in the attached schedule.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

34485-IX.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in thousands of euros, effective from 1 June 2016. It mainly reallocates amounts within the Financial Markets article, including higher costs for certification, ACM supervision of card transaction fees, and higher receipts from fines.
34485-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher certification costs after a deadline extension requested by the Tweede Kamer, ACM supervision costs, and receipts from fines, without a delegation or new power.
q: By decision, the ACM will be designated as supervisor for the implementation and enforcement of this regulation.
Bij besluit zal de ACM worden aangewezen als toezichthouder op de uitvoering en handhaving van deze verordening.

34550-VII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2017 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for the agency Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens. It sets appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2017.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2017 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34620-XII.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget (second supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budgets of its executive agencies, adjusting appropriations and expenditure by article. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We have, with the joint consultation of the States General, resolved that the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) for 2016 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd

34730-VII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2017 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget of the RvIG agency, shifting funds between articles and adding spending for elections and other items. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power and mainly reallocates appropriations in thousands of euros.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the budget for its agency.
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII)

34775-IV.s: The bill establishes the 2018 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds, setting expenditure, revenue and commitment figures in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers financial supervision of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, guarantees and loans, and Dutch support to Caribbean Netherlands.
q: The budget statements forming part of the national budget are each established separately by law under Article 1(3) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
De begrotingsstaten die onderdeel zijn van de Rijksbegroting, worden op grond van artikel 1, derde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 elk afzonderlijk bij de wet vastgesteld.

34775-VI.s: This bill sets the 2018 departmental budget for the Ministry of Security and Justice, including its policy articles, non-policy articles and budget for the agencies DJI, CJIB, NFI, IND and JUSTIS. It also clarifies that the Minister is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's operations but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Council for the Judiciary.
q: Referring to Article 21 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 in conjunction with Articles 23 and 91 of the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Minister of Security and Justice is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar het bepaalde in artikel 21 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

34845-IX.s: This bill amends the second supplementary budget (tweede suppletoire begroting) for 2017 for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA), changing appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It only adjusts budget figures and sets entry-into-force rules, and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35000-VIII.s: This bill sets the 2019 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, including appropriations for its operating agencies DUO and the National Archives. The explanatory memorandum sets out spending priorities, legally committed versus discretionary expenditure, and planned policy evaluations.
q: The budget statement annexed to this law for the year 2019 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35210-XV.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, changing expenditure and revenue lines following the Spring Memorandum. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
35210-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by revised forecasts of unemployment benefit volumes, average disability allowances, inflows into the benefit group, and continuation of the BCIT fraud-control business case.
q: In the cCEP forecast the WW volume was revised upward.
Bij de cCEP-raming is het WW-volume opwaarts bijgesteld.

35300-XV.s: This bill adopts the 2020 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, fixing expenditure, receipts and commitments in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes budget lines and policy goals but contains no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2020, attached to this act, is hereby adopted.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2019 that it had no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for all ministries and funds, recommending they be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 16 September 2019 states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in attachments.

35450-VII.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budgets of its executive agencies (first supplementary budget), adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue across policy articles such as housing, energy transition and spatial planning. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes; it is a purely financial adjustment effective retroactively from 1 May 2020.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for the year 2020 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35925-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the 2022 budget of the National Debt (IXA) in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force rule and orders publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the draft 2022 budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) and recommended submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that some budgets need amendments, referring to attached annexes.

36200-XV.s: This bill sets the 2023 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (SZW), fixing expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros across policy articles such as labour market, social assistance, disability, unemployment, childcare and pensions. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes spending, evaluations and program changes, and mentions oversight instruments such as the Arbeidsinspectie, UWV and SVB supervision and municipal enforcement.
36200-XV.j: The memorandum justifies budget changes by reference to the coronavirus-era support winding down and new challenges such as the war in Ukraine, inflation and labour shortages, without a delegation of powers.
q: Adopted departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2023
Vastgestelde departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2023

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport merely transmits the advice and notes some budget amendments are attached in separate annexes.

36350-VII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget statements for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and for its executive agencies, adjusting commitments, expenditure, revenue and capital flows by amounts listed in the attached tables. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the changes effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2023.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2023.

36600-XII.s: The bill sets the 2025 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (HXII) and the agency budget statement for Rijkswaterstaat and the KNMI, in thousands of euros. It also includes the explanatory memorandum, which describes ministerial roles across water, roads, aviation, shipping, environment, and inspection, without creating new delegated powers in the bill's own articles.
q: The cabinet is amending the law so the state secretary can intervene from system responsibility if the quality of VTH enforcement is insufficient.
Het kabinet past de wet aan opdat de staatssecretaris vanuit de stelselverantwoordelijkheid kan bijsturen als de kwaliteit van de VTH-uitvoering onvoldoende is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2024 that it had no remarks on the draft 2025 budget bill for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII), and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 16 September 2024 forwards the advice and notes that some budgets needed amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36800-VII.s: This bill sets the 2026 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement for its executive agencies, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the ministry's rule-of-law, democracy and good-governance programmes but does not itself delegate rule-making power.
q: The minister is the guardian of the Constitution.
De minister is hoeder van de Grondwet (GW).

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division found no remarks on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport accompanies the blanket advice and states that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36915-IX.s: This first supplementary budget bill for 2026 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA), with retroactive effect to 1 June 2026. Its main changes concern new EU e-commerce controls (handling fee), the financing of childcare funding reform costs, and a postponed Ukraine loan repayment.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2026 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2026 wordt gewijzigd
